expected_findings.title: Encryption at Rest
expected_findings.expected_evidence: The Vendor shall encrypt all Customer Data stored within Vendor-managed systems using AES-256 encryption or an equivalent industry-standard encryption method.
expected_findings.reason: The clause explicitly satisfies the stated encryption-at-rest requirement.

expected_findings.title: Breach Notification
expected_findings.expected_evidence: The Vendor shall notify the Customer of a confirmed security incident within thirty calendar days after completing its internal investigation.
expected_findings.reason: Thirty calendar days after investigation is longer and less definite than the required 72-hour deadline.

expected_findings.title: Audit Rights
expected_findings.reason: No clause grants the Customer audit, inspection, or independent-assurance access rights.

expected_findings.title: Data Retention
expected_findings.expected_evidence: The Vendor may retain Customer Data for a reasonable period following termination where necessary for operational, legal, backup, or dispute-resolution purposes.
expected_findings.reason: The phrase reasonable period does not provide a measurable duration or objective deletion trigger.

expected_findings.title: Subprocessor Notification
expected_evidence: The Vendor will publish an updated list of material subprocessors through its customer portal and will provide at least thirty days prior notice before appointing a new material subprocessor.

Notwithstanding Section 5.2, the Vendor may appoint a replacement subprocessor without prior notice when the Vendor determines that an urgent operational or security need exists. Notice will be provided when reasonably practicable after the appointment.
expected_findings.reason: The general prior-notice commitment conflicts with an exception allowing appointment before notice. Both clauses require human review.
